Is the title of the issue correct? As you are not adding support for Thread, but specifically for versions 1.2 and 1.3. I would change the title, as it will be the title of the commit message.

As for the pcap files, please let's create an issue and add the pcap there. That will result in that pcap landing in our internal test-suite which in turn allows us to further test the feature later on. You can reference the issue with "Fixes #xxxxx" as a single line at the end of the commit message
